import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
h={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
aa="A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V".split()
raw="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aa)}
Bm=np.array([[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in raw.strip().split("\n")],dtype=np.float64)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,0) for c in s])
G=10.0
def nwalign(a,b):
    ea,eb=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(a),len(b); S=Bm[np.ix_(ea,eb)]
    H=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); H[0]=-G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=-G*np.arange(n+1); j=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=np.empty(m+1); t[0]=H[i-1,0]-G
        t[1:]=np.maximum(H[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],H[i-1,1:]-G)
        H[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(t+G*j)-G*j
    i,k=n,m; A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 and k>0:
        if abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k-1]+S[i-1,k-1]))<1e-9: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[k-1]);i-=1;k-=1
        elif abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k]-G))<1e-9: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
        else: A.append("-");B.append(b[k-1]);k-=1
    while i>0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
    while k>0: A.append("-");B.append(b[k-1]);k-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])
def fa(acc): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=h,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

# ---- 1. is CH238_05280 a complete arginase-fold binuclear Mn hydrolase?
Q=fa("A0A855A6N2"); E=fa("P60651")   # E. coli SpeB agmatinase, Mn ligands H126 D153 H155 D157 D232 D234 (UniProt ACT/BINDING)
MN=[126,153,155,157,232,234]
A,B=nwalign(Q,E)
qi=ei=0; m={}
for x,y in zip(A,B):
    if x!="-": qi+=1
    if y!="-": ei+=1
    if y!="-" and x!="-": m[ei]=(qi,x)
print("Binuclear Mn site of the arginase fold, E. coli SpeB P60651 numbering -> C. leptum CH238_05280")
ok=0
for p in MN:
    q=m.get(p)
    print(f"  SpeB {E[p-1]}{p:<4} ->  CH238_05280 {q[1]}{q[0] if q else ''}   {'conserved' if q and q[1]==E[p-1] else 'DIFFERS'}")
    ok+= bool(q and q[1]==E[p-1])
print(f"  {ok}/6 Mn-coordinating residues conserved; global identity to E. coli SpeB over the alignment: "
      f"{100*sum(x==y for x,y in zip(A,B) if x!='-' and y!='-')/min(len(Q),len(E)):.1f}%")

# ---- 2. is the nearest-neighbour call taxonomic rather than functional?
F="accession,organism_name,ec,sequence,lineage,reviewed"
def seqs(q,size=60):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":q,"fields":F,"format":"tsv","size":size},headers=h,timeout=120)
    L=r.text.strip().split("\n"); hd=L[0].split("\t")
    return [dict(zip(hd,x.split("\t"))) for x in L[1:] if len(x.split("\t"))==len(hd)]
rows=[]
for q,lab,sz in [("ec:3.5.3.24","APAUH",60),("(ec:3.5.3.11) AND (reviewed:true)","agmatinase",60)]:
    for d in seqs(q,sz):
        s=d["Sequence"]
        if 200<len(s)<420: rows.append({"acc":d["Entry"],"ec_group":lab,"lin":d["Taxonomic lineage"],"seq":s})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates("acc").reset_index(drop=True)
def nwid(a,b):
    A,B=nwalign(a,b); return 100*sum(x==y for x,y in zip(A,B) if x!="-" and y!="-")/min(len(a),len(b))
df["pid"]=[nwid(Q,s) for s in df.seq]
df["bacillota"]=df.lin.str.contains("Bacillota")
print("\nIdentity to CH238_05280 by EC group and by phylum (C. leptum is Bacillota):")
tb=df.groupby(["ec_group","bacillota"]).pid.agg(["size","mean","max"]).round(1)
print(tb.to_string())
g1=df.pid[df.ec_group=="APAUH"]; g2=df.pid[df.ec_group=="agmatinase"]
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(g2,g1,alternative="two-sided")
print(f"\nEC group effect: agmatinase mean {g2.mean():.1f}% vs APAUH mean {g1.mean():.1f}%, Mann-Whitney p={p:.3g}")
b1=df.pid[df.bacillota]; b0=df.pid[~df.bacillota]
u2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(b1,b0,alternative="greater")
print(f"Phylum effect: Bacillota (n={len(b1)}) mean {b1.mean():.1f}% vs non-Bacillota (n={len(b0)}) mean {b0.mean():.1f}%, one-sided p={p2:.3g}")
print(f"Every Bacillota member of this panel is an agmatinase: {df[df.bacillota].ec_group.value_counts().to_dict()}")
print(f"Top hit P70999 (B. subtilis agmatinase) at {df.pid[df.acc=='P70999'].iloc[0]:.1f}%; "
      f"no Bacillota protein is annotated EC 3.5.3.24, so the class comparison is confounded with phylum.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5))
for k,(g,c) in enumerate([("agmatinase","#2f5d9e"),("APAUH","#c0392b")]):
    v=df.pid[df.ec_group==g]
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(v),k)+np.random.default_rng(k).uniform(-.18,.18,len(v)),v,s=22,color=c,alpha=.85)
    ax[0].hlines(v.mean(),k-.3,k+.3,color="k",lw=2)
ax[0].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[0].set_xticklabels(["agmatinase\nEC 3.5.3.11 (reviewed)","aminopropylagmatine\nureohydrolase, EC 3.5.3.24"])
ax[0].set_ylabel("% identity to C. leptum CH238_05280")
ax[0].set_title(f"The two candidate activities overlap: {g2.mean():.1f}% vs {g1.mean():.1f}% mean,\nMann-Whitney p = {p:.2g}. Identity cannot assign this gene.",fontsize=9)
sub=df.copy(); sub["cls"]=np.where(sub.bacillota,"Bacillota","other phyla")
for k,(c,col) in enumerate([("Bacillota","#009e73"),("other phyla","#b0b7c3")]):
    v=sub.pid[sub.cls==c]
    ax[1].scatter(np.full(len(v),k)+np.random.default_rng(k+5).uniform(-.18,.18,len(v)),v,s=22,color=col,alpha=.85)
    ax[1].hlines(v.mean(),k-.3,k+.3,color="k",lw=2)
ax[1].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"Bacillota (n={len(b1)})\nall annotated agmatinase",f"other phyla (n={len(b0)})"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("% identity to C. leptum CH238_05280")
ax[1].set_title(f"The nearest neighbours are Bacillota, the query's own phylum\n(p = {p2:.2g}), so the top hit reports relatedness, not activity.",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.drop(columns="seq").to_csv("speB_family_identity_by_ec_and_phylum.csv",index=False)
